name: smwmusic-rebecca-black-friday-sky-remix
title: Rebecca Black - Friday (Sky Remix)
description:
Hey guys, it's my birthday today! (The 22nd of June)
For this very special occasion, I decided to release one of my greatest remixes of all time, A Sky Remix of Rebecca Black's Friday!

Ported by request for ninj's 72hoQLDC entry.

Hope yall enjoy it, at least a tiny bit!
